name: Hedessa

attributes.attribute: British folkloric figure, a spirit of the small spring that bears her name in the Peaklands
may derive from an ancient water goddess
a small spring in the Peaklands named for the folkloric figure Hedessa

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Hedessa is a creature of British folklore. This spirit haunts a small spring in the Peaklands. The spring bears her name. It is called Hedess Spring. The spirit of Hedessa may come from an ancient water goddess. The record does not give her a story. She survives only as a name on a freshwater spring.

okr.objective: Document Hedessa, the British spring spirit of the Peaklands.
